comparable_decision_count: samples whose terminal state is a schema-valid allow or deny
input_token_source: exact frozen census count bound to the sample's canonical static payload
latency_scope: monotonic clock from immediately before the sample enters its request phase to its terminal state, including any granted infrastructure retry
name: rondo_l4_local_static_v1
percentile_method: nearest-rank on ascending observations: index = ceil(p / 100 * n), 1-based

public_projection.holdout: batch summary only; tasks must be null
public_projection.seed: batch summary plus body-free per-sample identity is allowed

purpose: frozen L4 approval-quality and engineering-usability metric contract for Local-static shadow replays of the Sol teacher batch
teacher_agreement_rate: teacher_agreement.numerator / comparable_decision_count; null when the denominator is zero
teacher_semantics: teacher labels are a point-in-time Sol distillation target, not human ground truth; differences are teacher disagreement and are never reported as false allow or false deny
thresholds: none; no mechanical pass or fail gate is derived from these numbers
usage_token_source: strictly validated service usage from the response envelope
vram_method: nvidia-smi device-level memory.used sampled every 200ms across the whole local batch lifecycle with no other CUDA compute process
vram_scope: peak bytes across the whole local batch lifecycle
